fact: The Anchor reports the Ministry of Health and Child Care, with World Bank and Cordaid support, launched a Digital Grievance Redress Mechanism with service ratings, free-text feedback, mobile apps and public feedback booths; no case numbers are given.
The Ministry of Public Service is presenting progress on a proposed Grievance Redress Feedback Mechanism in Stockholm, Zim Now reports.

The City of Bulawayo, with the Ministry of Local Government and Public Works, launched a digital Citizen Engagement Scorecard through which residents assess service delivery and give feedback; no case count is given.
